commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Having seen unsporting behavior, Bastien Dechepy shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is the recipient.
90+4' Isaak Toure (Lorient) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
90+3' Brice Samba (Lens) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
90+1' Formose Mendy (Lorient) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastien Dechepy had an easy-decision to make.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Lens will take a corner kick.
88' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
85' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul. Lorient have a free kick.

83' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Brice Samba sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the top right corner.
83' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
83' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
82' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lens.

81' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
80' Ayanda Sishuba (Lens) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Yvon Mvogo makes a comfortable save.
78' It looks like Bassirou Ndiaye (Lorient) saw red with that tackle. Bastien Dechepy won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Lens.
76' Substitution. Julien Ponceau (Lorient) makes way for Bassirou Ndiaye.
75' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Morgan Guilavogui will be replaced by Ayanda Sishuba (Lens).
75' Here is a change. Massadio Haidara (Lens) is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Deiver Machado.
74' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
74' Elye Wahi (Lens) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Yvon Mvogo, who pulls off a decent save!
72' Now Lens have a corner.

72' Elye Wahi (Lens) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Lens force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
70' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Lorient are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
68' Massadio Haidara (Lens) makes a slide tackle, but referee Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul. Lorient get a free kick.
66' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
64' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Salis Abdul Samed replacing Nampalys Mendy (Lens).
64' The substitution has been made. Adrien Thomasson has replaced Angelo Fulgini (Lens).
64' A substitution has been made. Andy Diouf (Lens) goes off and Elye Wahi comes on.
63' Massadio Haidara (Lens) makes a rough challenge and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Lorient in a dangerous position.
61' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
59' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) sends a cross into the box, but Brice Samba comes off his line to gather the ball.
56' Regis Le Bris has decided to make a change. Theo Le Bris (Lorient) replaces Joel Mvuka Mugisha.
56' Today's match ends for Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) who will be replaced by Eli Junior Kroupi.
55' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Tiemoue Bakayoko leaves the pitch to be replaced by Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient).
55' Andy Diouf (Lens) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
52' Looks like Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
51' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Bastien Dechepy saw the whole situation. Lorient will take a free kick.
49' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lorient, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
48' Yellow card. Kevin Danso (Lens) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
47' It's a nice effort by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Yvon Mvogo. Easy save.

47' That was absolutely fantastic! Florian Sotoca (Lens) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the crossbar! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.
46' Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Angelo Fulgini is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens). Lens force a corner. They send men into the box.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Bastien Dechepy has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Florian Sotoca (Lens) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
45+1' Isaak Toure (Lorient) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lens.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is caught offside!
40' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
38' Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul after Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
35' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes the corner.
35' Massadio Haidara (Lens) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The ball is out of play. Lens win a corner kick.
33' Florian Sotoca (Lens) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Nampalys Mendy. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
31' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) was too forceful with his tackle and Bastien Dechepy interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

29' What a wasted opportunity by Facundo Medina (Lens)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Yvon Mvogo makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
27' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Bastien Dechepy no option but to blow his whistle. Lens have a free kick.

26' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Yvon Mvogo, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
24' A player from Lens commits a rough challenge. Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick has been awarded to Lorient.
22' A corner kick by Lorient is thwarted by the well prepared Brice Samba (Lens).
22' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Lorient are awarded a corner kick.
19' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. A free kick to Lorient.
16' The ball possession is 42:58.
14' Poor challenge! Laurent Abergel (Lorient) is penalised for tripping and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle. Lens earn a free kick.
12' Massadio Haidara (Lens) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
9' Andy Diouf (Lens) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
8' Andy Diouf (Lens) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
7' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper, but his effort is straight at Yvon Mvogo, who is alert and makes an easy save to deny him.
5' Formose Mendy (Lorient) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Brice Samba, who smothers the ball.
3' Romain Faivre (Lorient) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
3' The game is interrupted as Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) is flagged offside.
2' A spell of possession for Lens in an attempt to control the game.
1' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Lorient.
1' The first half has started.
Lorient will kick-off.
Bastien Dechepy was nominated as the referee for this game.
